raw_response:
A is not well-posed as a non-circular bridge back to Window6/Fibonacci. It is only well-posed as a Window6 self-diagnostic or negative-control appendix.
The codon result lives in a canonical product association scheme:

$$H(3,4)=V_4^3,$$

where  $E_1$  means additive dependence on one of three codon positions, with each position carrying the chemical  $V_4$  characters. That is why the localization to position 3, position 1, weak/strong, and purine/pyrimidine is meaningful: it is single-position codon chemistry.
Window6 lives in a different carrier:

$$X_6=\{x\in\{0,1\}^6:\text{no adjacent 1s}\},
\quad |X_6|=21,$$

inside the Boolean cube  $Q_6$ , or as the Fibonacci cube  $\Gamma_6$ . Its natural spectral frames are Boolean Fourier degree on six binary coordinates, or the adjacency/Laplacian spectrum of  $\Gamma_6$ . Neither is canonically the same as  $E_1\subset H(3,4)$ .
You can compute Window6’s own spectral order:

$$f_W=\mathbf{1}_{X_6}-21/64,$$


$$f_W=\sum_{S\subseteq[6]}\hat f(S)\chi_S,$$


$$\rho_k(W)=
\frac{\sum_{|S|=k}\hat f(S)^2}
{\sum_{S\neq \varnothing}\hat f(S)^2},
\quad k=1,\ldots,6.$$

A fair null would be:

$$\Omega=\{S\subset Q_6: |S|=21,\ e(S)=38\},$$

preferably strengthened by also matching the coordinate-marginal multiset, because first-order Fourier energy is strongly affected by coordinate imbalance.
Then:


if  $\rho_1(W)$  is extreme, Window6 is first-order-dominated as a Boolean subset;


if  $\rho_2$  or higher-degree energy is extreme, Window6 is interaction-dominated;


if typical, its spectral profile is explained by size/edge/marginal constraints.


That is a legitimate pure-math diagnostic. But it does not bridge to codon  $E_1$ . Boolean degree 1 means one bit. Codon  $E_1$  means one codon position with four chemical states. To identify them, one must group six Window6 bits into three pairs and declare those pairs to be codon positions. That grouping is not forced by Window6. Choosing it because it gives an attractive comparison would be convention-circular.
Testing all 15 bit-pairings does not rescue it. If one special pairing works, the result is convention-dependent. If all pairings work, the result is generic to Window6 or to its size/edge profile, not a specific codon bridge. If no pairing works, the bridge remains closed.
So the honest verdict is:
the bridge is correctly bio-gated.
There is no remaining pure-math or public-data step that can non-vacuously connect the certified codon- $E_1$  residual back to Window6/Fibonacci. The structural program is genuinely exhausted as a bridge program. The optional Window6 Fourier profile is useful only as closure documentation: it can show that any proposed spectral comparison requires an extra non-canonical coordinate identification.
The core result should be stated cleanly: the hoped  $E_3$  bridge failed, and the real bio-intrinsic residual lives in ordinary first-order codon chemistry. That is biologically plausible and structurally informative, but it is not a Fibonacci signature.
The sharpest next question is: In a larger held-out organism panel, does the certified codon- $E_1$  wobble/position-1 residual remain reproducible after tRNA-tAI, TE, clade, and composition controls, or is it only a codon-spelling artifact?
